name: @parcel/api
description: Express + MongoDB API for the Parcel Management System

scripts.build: node --check src/server.js && node --check src/app.js && echo '@parcel/api: syntax OK'
scripts.lint: node --check src/server.js && node --check src/app.js && node --check src/config/env.js && node --check src/config/cloudinary.js && node --check src/middleware/error.js && node --check src/middleware/upload.js && node --check src/modules/uploads/upload.routes.js && node --check src/modules/uploads/upload.service.js && echo '@parcel/api: lint OK'
scripts.test: NODE_ENV=test node --test test/api.test.js test/authz.test.js test/uploads.test.js && node scripts/route-contract.test.js
